held.why: held: posted by the reread of the reconcile's records (force 45176404274) and still failing: its major reads 20-27, equal to the printed subtotal, and with Cal-GETC's 34 the degree reads 54-67 around the printed 60 with electives that fill it; no filed kind's sentence is true of a sum that holds its printed total. held: its movement-based list reads three courses at up to 4 units (major 20-33 against 20-27): a reread

records.words: The Required Core (48-50) includes 'Completion of Intermediate Algebra or its equivalent or higher Math course 3-5', which has no course code and is not recorded as a course; the listed courses sum to 45 units, plus 3-5 math units gives 48-50.

outcomes: Communicate and collaborate professionally and effectively with patients, healthcare team, and third-party providers in diverse environments.
Demonstrate a mastery of a complex body of knowledge and specialized skills in the cognitive (knowledge), psychomotor (skills), and affective (behavior) learning domains.
Demonstrate and practice behavior consistent with the legal and ethical standards of the profession.
Demonstrate standard, quality, safety, and risk-reduction precautions in the healthcare setting.
Prepare students to display professionalism and cultural sensitivity while interacting and communicating with providers, staff and patients.
Provide competent medical assisting care, in variety of settings, based on the entry-level competencies for a Medical Assistant.

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
